bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 166, Number 82 (Friday, May 1, 2020)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Mr. BURCHETT:
H.R. 6664.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
the authority enumerated in Clause 3 of Section 8 of
Article I of the United States Constitution
[Page H1973]

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, and in addition to the Committees on the Judiciary, and Small Business, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.

bill.title: Coronavirus Public Safety and Economic Recovery Act
